title: potentilla erecta var. typica
intro: Potentilla erecta var. typica, commonly known as American cinquefoil, is a plant species belonging to the rose family (Rosaceae). It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in wound healing and reducing the risk of chronic diseases like diabetes and cancer. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit cardiovascular protective effects, and possess antiproliferative properties. The bioactive constituents of Potentilla erecta var. typica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
